Looking at differences in expression from ribofree and polyA samples 

Load libraries 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(limma)
library(genefilter)
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)

if (!requireNamespace("TCseq", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("TCseq")
}

library(TCseq)
library(topGO)
```

```{r}
# Import count matrices
counts_rRNA <- read.csv(
  "../data/Molecular/mRNA/Mcap_gene_count_matrix.csv",
  check.names = FALSE)

counts_polyA <- read.csv(
  "../data/Molecular/mRNA_polyA/Mcap_polyA_gene_count_matrix.csv",
  check.names = FALSE)

# Extract TubeIDs from count matrix column names
rRNA_samples <- sub(
  "^([0-9]+).*", "M\\1",
  colnames(counts_rRNA)[-1]
)
colnames(counts_rRNA) <- gsub("^X", "M", sub("_.*", "", colnames(counts_rRNA))) # remove extra info from col name
colnames(counts_rRNA) <- paste0("M", colnames(counts_rRNA))

polyA_samples <- sub(
  "^(M[0-9]+).*", "\\1",
  colnames(counts_polyA)[-1]
)

# Read in metadata
tube_meta <- read.csv("../data/sample_metadata/tube_meta_mcap.csv")

# Extract TubeIDs from count matrix columns
sample_ids <- paste0(
  "M",
  stringr::str_extract(
    colnames(counts_rRNA)[-1],
    "\\d+"
  )
)

# Prepare count matrices
rownames(counts_rRNA) <- counts_rRNA$gene_id
counts_rRNA <- as.matrix(counts_rRNA[, -1])

rownames(counts_polyA) <- counts_polyA$gene_id
counts_polyA <- as.matrix(counts_polyA[, -1])

# Convert to integer counts
storage.mode(counts_rRNA) <- "integer"
storage.mode(counts_polyA) <- "integer"

# Build sample metadata
sample_meta <- tube_meta %>%
  filter(TubeID %in% unique(c(rRNA_samples, polyA_samples))) %>%
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", hpf)),
    hpf = factor(
      hpf,
      levels = c(
        "1 hpf", "4 hpf", "9 hpf", "14 hpf",
        "22 hpf", "28 hpf", "48 hpf", "72 hpf"
      )
    )
  )

# Check sample matching
stopifnot(setequal(rRNA_samples, sample_meta$TubeID))
stopifnot(setequal(polyA_samples, sample_meta$TubeID))

# Reorder metadata to match each matrix
meta_rRNA <- sample_meta[
  match(rRNA_samples, sample_meta$TubeID), ]

meta_polyA <- sample_meta[
  match(polyA_samples, sample_meta$TubeID), ]

stopifnot(identical(meta_rRNA$TubeID, rRNA_samples))
stopifnot(identical(meta_polyA$TubeID, polyA_samples))

rownames(meta_rRNA) <- meta_rRNA$TubeID
rownames(meta_polyA) <- meta_polyA$TubeID
```

Double check samples
```{r}
stopifnot(setequal(rRNA_samples, polyA_samples))
stopifnot(nrow(sample_meta) == 32)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sample_meta$TubeID))

table(sample_meta$hpf)

stopifnot(!anyNA(counts_rRNA))
stopifnot(!anyNA(counts_polyA))

stopifnot(all(counts_rRNA >= 0))
stopifnot(all(counts_polyA >= 0))
```

## rRNA-depleted

Check out library sizes of rRNA samples 
```{r}
# Calculate total library sizes
library_sizes <- colSums(counts_rRNA)

# Calculate number of detected genes
detected_genes <- colSums(counts_rRNA > 0)

# Combine into a QC dataframe
qc_rRNA <- data.frame(
  TubeID = colnames(counts_rRNA),
  LibrarySize = library_sizes,
  DetectedGenes = detected_genes
) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_rRNA %>% 
      select(TubeID, hpf),
    by = "TubeID"
  )

# Inspect results
qc_rRNA

# Plot library sizes
ggplot(qc_rRNA, aes(x = hpf, y = LibrarySize)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Total gene counts",
    title = "rRNA-depleted library sizes"
  )

# Plot detected genes
ggplot(qc_rRNA, aes(x = hpf, y = DetectedGenes)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Number of detected genes",
    title = "Genes detected per sample"
  )

```

DESeq2, PCA, and heatmap with rRNA depleted samples
```{r}
colnames(counts_rRNA) <- rRNA_samples
rownames(meta_rRNA) <- meta_rRNA$TubeID

stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_rRNA), rownames(meta_rRNA)))

# Create DESeq2 dataset
dds_rRNA <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_rRNA,
  colData = meta_rRNA,
  design = ~ hpf
)

# Apply your existing low-count filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_rRNA) >= 10) >= 4
dds_rRNA <- dds_rRNA[keep, ]

# Estimate size factors
dds_rRNA <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_rRNA)

# Variance-stabilizing transformation
vsd_rRNA <- vst(dds_rRNA, blind = TRUE)

# Extract transformed expression matrix
vsd_mat_rRNA <- assay(vsd_rRNA)

plotPCA(
  vsd_rRNA,
  intgroup = "hpf"
) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of rRNA-depleted libraries",
    color = "Developmental stage"
  )

# Calculate sample-to-sample distances
sample_dists <- dist(t(assay(vsd_rRNA)))

# Convert to a matrix for plotting
sample_dist_matrix <- as.matrix(sample_dists)

rownames(sample_dist_matrix) <- colnames(vsd_rRNA)
colnames(sample_dist_matrix) <- colnames(vsd_rRNA)

# Plot sample distance heatmap
pheatmap(
  sample_dist_matrix,
  annotation_col = data.frame(
    hpf = meta_rRNA$hpf,
    row.names = meta_rRNA$TubeID
  ),
  annotation_row = data.frame(
    hpf = meta_rRNA$hpf,
    row.names = meta_rRNA$TubeID
  ),
  clustering_distance_rows = sample_dists,
  clustering_distance_cols = sample_dists,
  main = "Sample-to-sample distances (rRNA-depleted)"
)
```

Run deseq2
```{r}
# Set reference stage
meta_rRNA$hpf <- relevel(meta_rRNA$hpf, ref = "1 hpf")

# Rebuild DESeq2 dataset with ordered metadata
dds_rRNA <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_rRNA,
  colData = meta_rRNA,
  design = ~ hpf
)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_rRNA) >= 10) >= 4
dds_rRNA <- dds_rRNA[keep, ]

# Run differential expression
dds_rRNA <- DESeq(dds_rRNA)

# Likelihood ratio test:
# Does developmental stage explain significant expression variation?
dds_lrt <- DESeq(
  dds_rRNA,
  test = "LRT",
  reduced = ~ 1
)

# Extract results
res_lrt <- results(dds_lrt)

# Summarize
summary(res_lrt)

# Count significantly changing genes
sum(res_lrt$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```

Extract results
```{r}
# Extract LRT results
res_lrt_df <- as.data.frame(res_lrt)

# Add gene IDs
res_lrt_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_lrt_df)

# Identify significant genes
sig_genes <- res_lrt_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.1)

# Summarize
nrow(sig_genes)

# Distribution of adjusted p-values
ggplot(
  res_lrt_df %>% filter(!is.na(padj)),
  aes(x = -log10(padj))
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    y = "Number of genes",
    title = "Developmental differential expression"
  )

# Count significant genes at both thresholds
sum(res_lrt$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(res_lrt$padj < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check the number of non-NA adjusted p-values
sum(!is.na(res_lrt$padj))

# Inspect the results object
head(res_lrt)
```

Extract sig genes and calculate expression
```{r}
# Extract significant genes
sig_genes <- res_lrt %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

# Extract normalized, variance-stabilized expression
sig_expr <- assay(vsd_rRNA)[sig_genes$gene_id, ]

# Convert to long format
expr_long <- as.data.frame(sig_expr) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "TubeID",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_rRNA %>% select(TubeID, hpf),
    by = "TubeID"
  )

# Average expression across biological replicates
mean_expr <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(gene_id, hpf) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Look at top 1000 variable genes
```{r}
# Variance-stabilizing transformation
vsd_rRNA <- vst(dds_rRNA, blind = FALSE)

# Extract expression matrix for significant genes
sig_expr <- assay(vsd_rRNA)[sig_genes$gene_id, ]

# Calculate variance across all samples for each gene
gene_variance <- apply(sig_expr, 1, var)

# Select the 1,000 most variable significant genes
top_genes <- names(
  sort(gene_variance, decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:1000]

# Subset expression matrix
heatmap_mat <- sig_expr[top_genes, ]

# Order samples by developmental stage
sample_order <- order(meta_rRNA$hpf)

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  ,
  meta_rRNA$TubeID[sample_order]
]

# Create column annotation
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  hpf = meta_rRNA$hpf[sample_order]
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- meta_rRNA$TubeID[sample_order]

# Generate heatmap
library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Developmental expression patterns in M. capitata"
)
```

Temporal clustering
```{r}
# Convert mean expression data into a gene-by-timepoint matrix
mean_expr_wide <- mean_expr %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = hpf,
    values_from = mean_expression
  )

# Convert to matrix
temporal_mat <- as.matrix(
  mean_expr_wide[, -1]
)

rownames(temporal_mat) <- mean_expr_wide$gene_id

# Scale each gene across developmental stages
temporal_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(temporal_mat)))

# Check dimensions
dim(temporal_mat_scaled)

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(temporal_mat_scaled))
```

TCseq
```{r}
# Cluster genes into 6 temporal expression patterns
tc_rRNA <- timeclust(
  temporal_mat_scaled,
  algo = "cm",
  k = 4,
  standardize = FALSE,
  dist = "correlation",
  iter.max = 100
)

# Plot temporal expression clusters
timeclustplot(
  tc_rRNA,
  value = "z-score",
  cols = 2
)

# List available slots
slotNames(tc_rRNA)

# Inspect the object structure
str(tc_rRNA, max.level = 2)
```

Look at cluster centers
```{r}
# Extract cluster centers
cluster_centers <- tc_rRNA@centers

# Convert to data frame
centers_df <- as.data.frame(cluster_centers) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -cluster,
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "z_score"
  )

# Preserve developmental time order
centers_df$timepoint <- factor(
  centers_df$timepoint,
  levels = colnames(temporal_mat_scaled)
)

# Plot
ggplot(
  centers_df,
  aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = z_score,
    group = cluster
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, ncol = 3) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Developmental expression profiles",
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Mean scaled expression (Z-score)"
  )

# Count genes assigned to each cluster
cluster_counts <- as.data.frame(
  table(tc_rRNA@cluster)
)

colnames(cluster_counts) <- c(
  "Cluster",
  "Number_of_genes"
)

cluster_counts

membership <- tc_rRNA@membership

# Highest membership score for each gene
max_membership <- apply(
  membership,
  1,
  max
)

summary(max_membership)

# how confidently do genes belong in each cluster?
# Convert membership matrix to long format
membership_df <- as.data.frame(membership)

membership_df$gene_id <- rownames(membership)

membership_long <- membership_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "cluster",
    values_to = "membership"
  )

# Plot membership distributions
ggplot(
  membership_long,
  aes(x = cluster, y = membership)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.1, size = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Fuzzy membership across developmental clusters",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Membership score"
  )
```

Let's try 3 clusters instead 
```{r}
# Run fuzzy c-means clustering with 4 clusters
tc_rRNA_4 <- timeclust(
  temporal_mat_scaled,
  algo = "cm",
  k = 3,
  standardize = FALSE
)

centers_4 <- tc_rRNA_4@centers
centers_4
table(tc_rRNA_4@cluster)

# Plot
centers_4_df <- as.data.frame(centers_4) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -cluster,
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "z_score"
  )

centers_4_df$timepoint <- factor(
  centers_4_df$timepoint,
  levels = colnames(temporal_mat_scaled)
)

ggplot(
  centers_4_df,
  aes(x = timepoint, y = z_score, group = cluster)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Developmental expression profiles (4 clusters)",
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Mean scaled expression (Z-score)"
  )

membership_3 <- tc_rRNA_4@membership

max_membership_3 <- apply(
  membership_3,
  1,
  max
)

summary(max_membership_3)

cluster_genes_3 <- data.frame(
  gene_id = names(tc_rRNA_4@cluster),
  cluster = tc_rRNA_4@cluster,
  membership = max_membership_3
)

# Inspect cluster sizes
table(cluster_genes_3$cluster)
```

Read in functional annotation
```{r}
annot <- read.delim("../data/Molecular/Montipora_capitata_HIv3_Swissprot_GO.tsv")
```

Run functional enrichment - cluster 1
```{r}
# Prepare gene-to-GO mapping
gene2GO <- annot %>%
  dplyr::select(query, GeneOntologyIDs) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneOntologyIDs), GeneOntologyIDs != "") %>%
  separate_rows(GeneOntologyIDs, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
  filter(GeneOntologyIDs != "") %>%
  group_by(query) %>%
  summarise(GO = list(unique(GeneOntologyIDs)), .groups = "drop")

# Convert to the format expected by topGO
gene2GO_list <- setNames(gene2GO$GO, gene2GO$query)

# Check the mapping
length(gene2GO_list)
head(gene2GO_list, 3)

# Define background: DESeq2-tested genes with GO annotations
gene_universe <- intersect(
  rownames(dds_rRNA),
  names(gene2GO_list)
)

# Define genes assigned to Cluster 1
cluster1_genes <- intersect(
  cluster_genes_3$gene_id[cluster_genes_3$cluster == 1],
  gene_universe
)

# Check sizes
length(gene_universe)
length(cluster1_genes)

geneList <- factor(as.integer(
  gene_universe %in% cluster1_genes
))
names(geneList) <- gene_universe
table(geneList)

GOdata_BP1 <- new(
  "topGOdata",
  ontology = "BP",
  allGenes = geneList,
  annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
  gene2GO = gene2GO_list,
  nodeSize = 10
)

result_BP1 <- runTest(
  GOdata_BP1,
  algorithm = "weight01",
  statistic = "fisher"
)

results_BP1 <- GenTable(
  GOdata_BP1,
  weight01 = result_BP1,
  orderBy = "weight01",
  topNodes = 30
)
head(results_BP1, 30)

# Get genes associated with selected GO terms
genes_BP1 <- genesInTerm(
  GOdata_BP1,
  c("GO:0002181", "GO:0006412", "GO:0006099")
)

# Keep only genes belonging to Cluster 1
genes_BP1_cluster <- lapply(
  genes_BP1,
  function(x) intersect(x, cluster1_genes)
)

# Display the number of Cluster 1 genes per term
sapply(genes_BP1_cluster, length)

# Combine genes from the selected terms
genes_to_inspect <- unique(unlist(genes_BP1_cluster))

gene_info <- annot %>%
  filter(query %in% genes_to_inspect) %>%
  dplyr::select(query, ProteinNames, BiologicalProcess)

head(gene_info, 20)

# Get the TCA-cycle genes in Cluster 1
tca_genes <- genes_BP1_cluster[["GO:0006099"]]

# Inspect their annotations
tca_info <- annot %>%
  filter(query %in% tca_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(query, ProteinNames, BiologicalProcess)
tca_info

genes_BP1_cluster[["GO:0007267"]] <- intersect(
  genesInTerm(GOdata_BP1, "GO:0007267")[[1]],
  cluster1_genes
)

length(genes_BP1_cluster[["GO:0007267"]])
signaling_info <- annot %>%
  filter(query %in% genes_BP1_cluster[["GO:0007267"]]) %>%
  dplyr::select(query, ProteinNames, BiologicalProcess)

head(signaling_info, 30)
```

Run deseq2
```{r}
# Set reference stage
meta_polyA$hpf <- relevel(meta_polyA$hpf, ref = "1 hpf")

# Rebuild DESeq2 dataset with ordered metadata
dds_polyA <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_polyA,
  colData = meta_polyA,
  design = ~ hpf
)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_polyA) >= 10) >= 4
dds_polyA <- dds_polyA[keep, ]

# Run differential expression
dds_polyA <- DESeq(dds_polyA)

# Likelihood ratio test:
# Does developmental stage explain significant expression variation?
dds_lrt_polyA <- DESeq(
  dds_polyA,
  test = "LRT",
  reduced = ~ 1
)

# Extract results
res_lrt_polyA <- results(dds_lrt_polyA)

# Summarize
summary(res_lrt_polyA)

# Count significantly changing genes
sum(res_lrt_polyA$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```

Extract results
```{r}
# Extract LRT results
res_lrt_polyA_df <- as.data.frame(res_lrt_polyA)

# Add gene IDs
res_lrt_polyA_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_lrt_polyA_df)

# Identify significant genes
sig_genes_polyA <- res_lrt_polyA_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.1)

# Summarize
nrow(sig_genes_polyA)

# Distribution of adjusted p-values
ggplot(

) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +

sum(res_lrt_polyA$padj < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

head(res_lrt_polyA)

sum(!is.na(res_lrt_polyA$padj) & res_lrt_polyA$padj < 0.05)
```

Look at overlap between library sets 
```{r}
sig_polyA_ids <- sig_polyA$GeneID
sig_ribo_ids  <- sig_ribo$GeneID

length(intersect(sig_polyA_ids, sig_ribo_ids))
length(setdiff(sig_ribo_ids, sig_polyA_ids))   # significant in ribo only — deadenylation/maternal candidates
length(setdiff(sig_polyA_ids, sig_ribo_ids))   # significant in polyA only — re-polyadenylation candidates

# genes in the ribo-only significant set that are also essentially undetected in polyA at every stage
mean_polyA_counts <- rowMeans(counts(dds_polyA, normalized = TRUE))
ribo_only <- setdiff(sig_ribo_ids, sig_polyA_ids)

# how many of these were even testable in polyA (i.e., passed the polyA filter) vs never detected there at all
ribo_only_tested_in_polyA <- ribo_only[ribo_only %in% rownames(dds_polyA)]
ribo_only_never_in_polyA  <- setdiff(ribo_only, rownames(dds_polyA))

length(ribo_only_tested_in_polyA)  # real deadenylation/maternal candidates - detectable in both, but only sig in ribo
length(ribo_only_never_in_polyA)   # never had meaningful polyA signal at all - likely non-polyadenylated transcripts (e.g. histones, some ncRNAs)
```

```{r}
library(Mfuzz)
library(Biobase)

# build ExpressionSet from mean-per-timepoint vst values (Mfuzz expects one column per condition, not per replicate)
mat_polyA_mean <- combined_counts %>%
  filter(Library == "polyA", GeneID %in% sig_polyA$GeneID) %>%
  # merge in vst values instead of raw counts - see note below
  ...

# simplest path: average your vsd matrix across replicates per hpf
avg_by_hpf <- function(mat, meta) {
  hpf_levels <- levels(meta$hpf_clean)
  sapply(hpf_levels, function(h) {
    samples <- meta$SampleID[meta$hpf_clean == h]
    rowMeans(mat[, samples, drop = FALSE])
  })
}

mat_polyA_avg <- avg_by_hpf(mat_polyA_sig, meta_polyA)
eset_polyA <- ExpressionSet(assayData = mat_polyA_avg)
eset_polyA <- standardise(eset_polyA)  # z-score each gene across time - required for Mfuzz

m_polyA <- mestimate(eset_polyA)  # estimate fuzzification parameter
c_polyA <- mfuzz(eset_polyA, c = 8, m = m_polyA)  # c = number of clusters - tune this

mfuzz.plot2(eset_polyA, cl = c_polyA, mfrow = c(3,3), time.labels = colnames(mat_polyA_avg))
```







Reshape data to prep for DESeq2
```{r}
# Create unique sample identifier combining TubeID and Library type
combined_counts <- combined_counts %>%
  mutate(SampleID = paste(TubeID, Library, sep = "_"))

# Pivot to wide Count Matrix (Genes x Samples)
count_matrix <- combined_counts %>%
  select(GeneID, SampleID, Counts) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SampleID, values_from = Counts, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("GeneID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Clean up factor formatting for hpf
combined_counts <- combined_counts %>%
  mutate(hpf_clean = gsub(" hpf", "", as.character(hpf)),
         hpf_clean = factor(hpf_clean, levels = c("1", "4", "9", "14", "22", "28", "48", "72")))

# Create Metadata (colData) preserving TubeID pairing
col_data <- combined_counts %>%
  distinct(SampleID, TubeID, Library, hpf_clean, Date, EmbryosPerTube) %>%
  mutate(
    Library = factor(Library, levels = c("ribo", "polyA")), # "ribo" as reference/total RNA baseline
    TubeID = factor(TubeID),
    hpf = hpf_clean
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID")

# Ensure count matrix columns match col_data rows exactly
count_matrix <- count_matrix[, rownames(col_data)]
stopifnot(all(colnames(count_matrix) == rownames(col_data)))
```

Build interaction model with DESeq2
```{r}
# Construct DESeq2 Object with Paired Nested Design
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(count_matrix),
  colData   = col_data,
  design    = ~ Library + hpf + Library:hpf
)

# Filter low-count genes (e.g., at least 10 counts across at least 4 samples)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 4
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# Run DESeq pipeline
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Inspect available contrasts/results
resultsNames(dds)
```

Extract maternal and zygotic kinetics 
```{r}
# Transform counts with Variance Stabilizing Transformation (VST)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)

# Calculate stage-specific Delta Log2 (PolyA Efficiency / Tail Index)
# For every matched TubeID, subtract ribo VST value from polyA VST value
sample_pairs <- col_data %>%
  select(TubeID, Library, hpf) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Library, values_from = SampleID)

# Calculate PolyA Tail Ratio Matrix (Genes x Tubes)
polyA_ratio_mat <- sapply(1:nrow(sample_pairs), function(i) {
  poly_col <- sample_pairs$polyA[i]
  ribo_col <- sample_pairs$ribo[i]
  vsd_mat[, poly_col] - vsd_mat[, ribo_col]
})
colnames(polyA_ratio_mat) <- sample_pairs$TubeID

# Build Tube metadata mapping for Ratios
ratio_metadata <- sample_pairs %>%
  select(TubeID, hpf) %>%
  distinct()
```

Classify into regulatory categories
```{r}
# Calculate average expression across timepoints for both Library types
get_group_means <- function(mat, meta, group_var) {
  t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) tapply(x, meta[[group_var]], mean)))
}

mean_polyA <- get_group_means(vsd_mat[, col_data$Library == "polyA"], 
                             col_data[col_data$Library == "polyA", ], "hpf")

mean_ribo  <- get_group_means(vsd_mat[, col_data$Library == "ribo"], 
                             col_data[col_data$Library == "ribo", ], "hpf")

mean_ratio <- mean_polyA - mean_ribo

# Classify Maternal Clearance vs ZGA
transcript_dynamics <- tibble(
  GeneID = rownames(mean_ribo),
  # Maternal presence: high Total RNA at 1 hpf
  is_maternal = mean_ribo[, "1"] > median(mean_ribo[, "1"]),
  # De-adenylation: PolyA/Total ratio drops sharply between 1 and 9 hpf
  deadenylation_delta = mean_ratio[, "9"] - mean_ratio[, "1"],
  # Total RNA decay: Total RNA drops between 1 and 14 hpf
  ribo_decay_delta = mean_ribo[, "14"] - mean_ribo[, "1"],
  # ZGA: Total RNA increases significantly post 9 hpf
  zga_induction_delta = mean_ribo[, "28"] - mean_ribo[, "9"]
) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = case_when(
      is_maternal & deadenylation_delta < -1 & ribo_decay_delta < -1 ~ "Maternal Clearance (De-adenylation Dependent)",
      is_maternal & deadenylation_delta >= -0.5 & ribo_decay_delta < -1 ~ "Maternal Clearance (Direct Cleavage)",
      !is_maternal & zga_induction_delta > 1.5 ~ "Zygotic Genome Activation (ZGA)",
      is_maternal & deadenylation_delta > 1 ~ "Cytoplasmic Polyadenylation (Translational Activation)",
      TRUE ~ "Stable / Other"
    )
  )

table(transcript_dynamics$Class)
```

Plot dynamics over time
```{r}
# 1. Convert mean matrices to long format
polyA_long <- mean_polyA %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("GeneID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-GeneID, names_to = "hpf", values_to = "expr_polyA")

ribo_long <- mean_ribo %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("GeneID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-GeneID, names_to = "hpf", values_to = "expr_ribo")

# 2. Merge expression data with classification
dynamics_long <- polyA_long %>%
  inner_join(ribo_long, by = c("GeneID", "hpf")) %>%
  mutate(
    hpf = as.character(hpf),
    ratio = expr_polyA - expr_ribo
  ) %>%
  inner_join(transcript_dynamics %>% select(GeneID, Class), by = "GeneID")
table(dynamics_long$Class)

# 3. Calculate summary statistics per class per hpf
summary_dynamics <- dynamics_long %>%
  group_by(Class, hpf) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ribo = mean(expr_ribo, na.rm = TRUE),
    #se_ribo   = sd(expr_ribo, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_polyA = mean(expr_polyA, na.rm = TRUE),
    #se_polyA   = sd(expr_polyA, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    #se_ratio   = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4. Plot Total RNA (ribo-minus) trajectories by class (Excluding Stable / Other for clarity)
ggplot(summary_dynamics %>% filter(Class != "Stable / Other"), 
       aes(x = hpf, y = mean_ribo, color = Class, group = Class)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_ribo - se_ribo, ymax = mean_ribo + se_ribo, fill = Class), 
  #            alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Total RNA (ribo-zero) Dynamics Across Development",
    x = "Hours Post Fertilization (hpf)",
    y = "Mean Expression (vsd)",
    color = "Transcript Class",
    fill = "Transcript Class"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```





















Normalize counts data - counts per million
```{r}
library_sizes <- combined_counts %>%
  group_by(Library, TubeID) %>%
  summarize(LibSize = sum(Counts))

# Add CPM
combined_counts <- combined_counts %>%
  left_join(library_sizes, by = c("Library", "TubeID")) %>%
  mutate(CPM = (Counts / LibSize) * 1e6)
```

Plot example gene: 
```{r}
# Subset one gene
gene_of_interest <- "Montipora_capitata_HIv3___TS.g40891.t1b"

gene_plot <- combined_counts %>%
  filter(GeneID == gene_of_interest)

ggplot(gene_plot, aes(x = hpf, y = CPM, color = Library, group = Library)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = gene_of_interest,
       x = "Hours post fertilization (hpf)",
       y = "CPM",
       color = "Library") +
  theme_minimal()

```

Calculate mean CPM per gene/timepoint/library
```{r}
mean_cpm <- combined_counts %>%
  group_by(GeneID, hpf, Library) %>%
  summarize(mean_CPM = mean(CPM), .groups = "drop")
```

Pivot table 
```{r}
library_wide <- mean_cpm %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Library,
              values_from = mean_CPM,
              values_fill = 0)  # fill missing with 0
```

Compute the ratio (polyA / ribofree for each gene for each timepoint) and plot
```{r}
library_wide <- library_wide %>%
  mutate(Ratio = polyA / (ribo + 1))

# Plot example for one gene
gene_plot <- library_wide %>%
  filter(GeneID == "Montipora_capitata_HIv3___RNAseq.g45549.t1")

ggplot(gene_plot, aes(x = hpf, y = Ratio)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "PolyA / rRNA ratio",
       x = "hpf",
       y = "Ratio (polyA / rRNA)",
       subtitle = unique(gene_plot$GeneID)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Summarize the ratio data based on expected biological outcomes. Here, I am using 4hpf as the early timepoint and 48 hpf as the later timepoint. 
```{r}
library_wide <- library_wide %>%
  mutate(hpf_num = as.numeric(str_remove(as.character(hpf), " hpf")))

ratio_summary <- library_wide %>%
  group_by(GeneID) %>%
  summarize(
    early_ratio = mean(Ratio[hpf_num <= 4], na.rm = TRUE),
    late_ratio = mean(Ratio[hpf_num >= 48], na.rm = TRUE),
    overall_ratio = mean(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio_change = late_ratio - early_ratio,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ratio_summary <- ratio_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      ratio_change < -0.2 & early_ratio > 1 ~ "Drops: Maternal clearance",
      ratio_change > 0.2 & late_ratio > 1 ~ "Rises: Zygotic activation",
      overall_ratio < 0.5 ~ "Stays low: Non-polyA",
      overall_ratio > 1 ~ "Stays high: Stable polyA",
      TRUE ~ "Other/Unclear"
    )
  )
ratio_summary %>%
  count(Category) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

Probably would be best to rlog for expression patterns and CPM/TPM for ratios













## DE 

### 1 v 4 hpf

Read in polyA v ribofree 1v4hpf
```{r}
polyA_de <- read.csv("../output/Molecular/mRNA_polyA/mRNA_DE_results_sig_1v4_wald_polyA.csv")
colnames(polyA_de)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(polyA_de)[-1] <- paste0("polyA_", colnames(polyA_de)[-1])

ribofree_de <- read.csv("../output/Molecular/mRNA/mRNA_DE_results_sig_1v4_wald.csv")
colnames(ribofree_de)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(ribofree_de)[-1] <- paste0("ribofree_", colnames(ribofree_de)[-1])
```

Find shared and unique genes  
```{r}
# Get the gene IDs from each dataframe
ribofree_genes <- ribofree_de$gene_id
polya_genes <- polyA_de$gene_id

# Shared genes
shared_genes <- intersect(ribofree_genes, polya_genes)

# Unique to ribofree
unique_ribofree <- setdiff(ribofree_genes, polya_genes)

# Unique to polyA
unique_polya <- setdiff(polya_genes, ribofree_genes)

# New df with shared genes 
ribofree_shared <- ribofree_de[ribofree_de$gene_id %in% shared_genes, ]
polya_shared <- polyA_de[polyA_de$gene_id %in% shared_genes, ]

# New df with unique genes 
ribofree_unique <- ribofree_de[ribofree_de$gene_id %in% unique_ribofree, ]
polya_unique <- polyA_de[polyA_de$gene_id %in% unique_polya, ]
```

Merge shared dfs 
```{r}
# Merge shared genes dataframes
shared_de <- merge(polya_shared, ribofree_shared, by = "gene_id")

# Classify genes based on expression changes
shared_de <- shared_de %>%
  mutate(regulation_category = case_when(
    polyA_regulation == "Up at 4 hpf" & ribofree_regulation == "Up at 4 hpf" ~ "Transcriptional Up",
    polyA_regulation == "Up at 1 hpf" & ribofree_regulation == "Up at 1 hpf" ~ "Transcriptional Down",
    polyA_regulation == "Up at 4 hpf" & ribofree_regulation == "Up at 1 hpf" ~ "Deadenylation",
    polyA_regulation == "Up at 1 hpf" & ribofree_regulation == "Up at 4 hpf" ~ "Readenylation",
    polyA_regulation == "Up at 4 hpf" & ribofree_regulation == "NS" ~ "PolyA Increase, Transcription Unchanged",
    polyA_regulation == "Up at 1 hpf" & ribofree_regulation == "NS" ~ "PolyA Decrease, Transcription Unchanged",
    ribofree_regulation == "Up at 4 hpf" & polyA_regulation == "NS" ~ "Ribofree Increase, PolyA Unchanged",
    ribofree_regulation == "Up at 1 hpf" & polyA_regulation == "NS" ~ "Ribofree Decrease, PolyA Unchanged",
    TRUE ~ "Complex/Other"
  ))

# Summarize regulation categories
category_summary <- shared_de %>%
  group_by(regulation_category) %>%
  summarize(count = n())
```
